lines.zh: 我现在在北京学中文。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiàn zài zài Běi jīng xué Zhōng wén.
lines.en: I am studying Chinese in Beijing now.

lines.zh: 星期六，我和同学去公园。
lines.pinyin: Xīng qī liù, wǒ hé tóng xué qù gōng yuán.
lines.en: On Saturday, I go to the park with a classmate.

lines.zh: 我们看见很多人在走路。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn jiàn hěn duō rén zài zǒu lù.
lines.en: We see many people walking.

lines.zh: 一个爷爷对我们笑。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yé ye duì wǒ men xiào.
lines.en: An elderly man smiles at us.

lines.zh: 我用中文说早上好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòng Zhōng wén shuō zǎo shang hǎo.
lines.en: I say good morning in Chinese.

lines.zh: 中午，我们吃了北京烤鸭。
lines.pinyin: Zhōng wǔ, wǒ men chī le Běi jīng kǎo yā.
lines.en: At noon, we eat Beijing roast duck.

lines.zh: 我给家人发了几张照片。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi jiā rén fā le jǐ zhāng zhào piàn.
lines.en: I send my family a few photos.

lines.zh: 这是我在北京的第一个周末。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zài Běi jīng de dì yī ge zhōu mò.
lines.en: This is my first weekend in Beijing.

lines.zh: 我来上海已经一个月了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lái Shàng hǎi yǐ jīng yí ge yuè le.
lines.en: I have been in Shanghai for a month.

lines.zh: 下课以后，我和朋友去外滩。
lines.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ hé péng you qù Wài tān.
lines.en: After class, I go to the Bund with a friend.

lines.zh: 我们站在黄浦江边。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men zhàn zài Huáng pǔ Jiāng biān.
lines.en: We stand beside the Huangpu River.

lines.zh: 江对面有很多高楼。
lines.pinyin: Jiāng duì miàn yǒu hěn duō gāo lóu.
lines.en: There are many tall buildings across the river.

lines.zh: 天黑了，灯也亮了。
lines.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, dēng yě liàng le.
lines.en: It gets dark, and the lights come on.

lines.zh: 我想拍照，手机却没电了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng pāi zhào, shǒu jī què méi diàn le.
lines.en: I want to take a photo, but my phone is out of battery.

lines.zh: 朋友用他的手机帮我拍。
lines.pinyin: Péng you yòng tā de shǒu jī bāng wǒ pāi.
lines.en: My friend takes a photo of me with his phone.

lines.zh: 这张照片让我想起那个晚上。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhào piàn ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà ge wǎn shang.
lines.en: This photo reminds me of that evening.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次过端午节。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì guò Duān wǔ Jié.
lines.en: This is my first Dragon Boat Festival.

lines.zh: 中国朋友请我去他家。
lines.pinyin: Zhōng guó péng you qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā.
lines.en: A Chinese friend invites me to his home.

lines.zh: 他妈妈正在厨房里包粽子。
lines.pinyin: Tā mā ma zhèng zài chú fáng lǐ bāo zòng zi.
lines.en: His mother is wrapping zongzi in the kitchen.

lines.zh: 她教我把米放进叶子里。
lines.pinyin: Tā jiāo wǒ bǎ mǐ fàng jìn yè zi lǐ.
lines.en: She teaches me to put rice inside the leaves.

lines.zh: 我包得不太好，大家都笑了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bāo de bú tài hǎo, dà jiā dōu xiào le.
lines.en: I do not wrap it very well, and everyone laughs.

lines.zh: 她说，多做几次就会了。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, duō zuò jǐ cì jiù huì le.
lines.en: She says I will learn with a little more practice.

lines.zh: 下午，我们一起看龙舟比赛。
lines.pinyin: Xià wǔ, wǒ men yì qǐ kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài.
lines.en: In the afternoon, we watch a dragon boat race together.

lines.zh: 我觉得自己像这个家的一员。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zì jǐ xiàng zhè ge jiā de yì yuán.
lines.en: I feel like a member of this family.

lines.zh: 今天是元宵节。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān shì Yuán xiāo Jié.
lines.en: Today is the Lantern Festival.

lines.zh: 晚上，我和同学一起出门。
lines.pinyin: Wǎn shang, wǒ hé tóng xué yì qǐ chū mén.
lines.en: In the evening, my classmates and I go out together.

lines.zh: 街上有很多漂亮的花灯。
lines.pinyin: Jiē shang yǒu hěn duō piào liang de huā dēng.
lines.en: There are many beautiful lanterns on the street.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢那只小兔子灯。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huan nà zhī xiǎo tù zi dēng.
lines.en: I like the little rabbit lantern best.

lines.zh: 朋友给我拍了一张照片。
lines.pinyin: Péng you gěi wǒ pāi le yì zhāng zhào piàn.
lines.en: My friend takes a photo of me.

lines.zh: 后来，我们去吃汤圆。
lines.pinyin: Hòu lái, wǒ men qù chī tāng yuán.
lines.en: Later, we go to eat tangyuan.

lines.zh: 汤圆很甜，我吃了三个。
lines.pinyin: Tāng yuán hěn tián, wǒ chī le sān ge.
lines.en: The rice balls are sweet, and I eat three.

lines.zh: 我想把今天的事告诉家人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ jīn tiān de shì gào su jiā rén.
lines.en: I want to tell my family about today.

lines.zh: 春天来了，天气暖和了。
lines.pinyin: Chūn tiān lái le, tiān qì nuǎn huo le.
lines.en: Spring is here, and the weather is warmer.

lines.zh: 星期天，我们去公园野餐。
lines.pinyin: Xīng qī tiān, wǒ men qù gōng yuán yě cān.
lines.en: On Sunday, we have a picnic in the park.

lines.zh: 我带了面包和几个苹果。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dài le miàn bāo hé jǐ ge píng guǒ.
lines.en: I bring bread and a few apples.

lines.zh: 朋友带了水和一个小球。
lines.pinyin: Péng you dài le shuǐ hé yí ge xiǎo qiú.
lines.en: My friend brings water and a small ball.

lines.zh: 我们坐在树下吃东西。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò zài shù xià chī dōng xi.
lines.en: We sit under a tree and eat.

lines.zh: 吃完以后，我们一起玩球。
lines.pinyin: Chī wán yǐ hòu, wǒ men yì qǐ wán qiú.
lines.en: After eating, we play ball together.

lines.zh: 我学会了一个新的中文词。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué huì le yí ge xīn de Zhōng wén cí.
lines.en: I learn a new Chinese word.

lines.zh: 这个词就是野餐。
lines.pinyin: Zhè ge cí jiù shì yě cān.
lines.en: That word is picnic.

lines.zh: 今天下午，天气很热。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān xià wǔ, tiān qì hěn rè.
lines.en: This afternoon, it is very hot.

lines.zh: 下课以后，我走路回家。
lines.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ zǒu lù huí jiā.
lines.en: After class, I walk home.

lines.zh: 走到一半，天突然黑了。
lines.pinyin: Zǒu dào yí bàn, tiān tū rán hēi le.
lines.en: Halfway home, the sky suddenly turns dark.

lines.zh: 很快就下起了大雨。
lines.pinyin: Hěn kuài jiù xià qǐ le dà yǔ.
lines.en: Soon it starts raining heavily.

lines.zh: 我没带伞，只好在店里等。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi dài sǎn, zhǐ hǎo zài diàn lǐ děng.
lines.en: I have no umbrella, so I have to wait in a shop.

lines.zh: 老板让我坐下，还给我水。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn ràng wǒ zuò xià, hái gěi wǒ shuǐ.
lines.en: The owner lets me sit down and gives me water.

lines.zh: 雨停了，我向他道谢。
lines.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, wǒ xiàng tā dào xiè.
lines.en: When the rain stops, I thank him.

lines.zh: 这场雨让我认识了一个好人。
lines.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ ràng wǒ rèn shi le yí ge hǎo rén.
lines.en: This rain helps me meet a kind person.

lines.zh: 窗外的树叶变黄了。
lines.pinyin: Chuāng wài de shù yè biàn huáng le.
lines.en: The leaves outside my window have turned yellow.

lines.zh: 这是我在中国的第一个秋天。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zài Zhōng guó de dì yī ge qiū tiān.
lines.en: This is my first autumn in China.

lines.zh: 我坐在桌前给家里写信。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài zhuō qián gěi jiā lǐ xiě xìn.
lines.en: I sit at my desk and write a letter home.

lines.zh: 我说，早上出门要穿外套了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, zǎo shang chū mén yào chuān wài tào le.
lines.en: I say that I now need a jacket in the morning.

lines.zh: 我的中文也比以前好了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōng wén yě bǐ yǐ qián hǎo le.
lines.en: My Chinese is better than before, too.

lines.zh: 可是，有时候我还是很想家。
lines.pinyin: Kě shì, yǒu shí hou wǒ hái shì hěn xiǎng jiā.
lines.en: But sometimes I still miss home a lot.

lines.zh: 我把一片树叶放进信里。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yí piàn shù yè fàng jìn xìn lǐ.
lines.en: I put a leaf inside the letter.

lines.zh: 希望家人也能看见这里的秋天。
lines.pinyin: Xī wàng jiā rén yě néng kàn jiàn zhè lǐ de qiū tiān.
lines.en: I hope my family can see a little of autumn here.

lines.zh: 早上，我打开窗户。
lines.pinyin: Zǎo shang, wǒ dǎ kāi chuāng hu.
lines.en: In the morning, I open the window.

lines.zh: 外面全白了，下雪了！
lines.pinyin: Wài mian quán bái le, xià xuě le!
lines.en: Everything outside is white. It has snowed!

lines.zh: 我的家乡很热，我没见过雪。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de jiā xiāng hěn rè, wǒ méi jiàn guo xuě.
lines.en: My hometown is hot, and I have never seen snow.

lines.zh: 我马上给朋友打电话。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mǎ shàng gěi péng you dǎ diàn huà.
lines.en: I call my friend right away.

lines.zh: 她说，穿好衣服再出来。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, chuān hǎo yī fu zài chū lái.
lines.en: She says to get dressed warmly before coming out.

lines.zh: 我们在楼下做了一个雪人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men zài lóu xià zuò le yí ge xuě rén.
lines.en: We make a snowman downstairs.

lines.zh: 我的手很冷，心里却很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu hěn lěng, xīn lǐ què hěn gāo xìng.
lines.en: My hands are cold, but I feel very happy.

lines.zh: 我要记住这个特别的早上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào jì zhù zhè ge tè bié de zǎo shang.
lines.en: I want to remember this special morning.

lines.zh: 我的同学来自日本。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de tóng xué lái zì Rì běn.
lines.en: My classmate is from Japan.

lines.zh: 日本在亚洲。
lines.pinyin: Rì běn zài Yà zhōu.
lines.en: Japan is in Asia.

lines.zh: 她现在和我一起学中文。
lines.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài hé wǒ yì qǐ xué Zhōng wén.
lines.en: She is studying Chinese with me now.

lines.zh: 她给我看了她家附近的照片。
lines.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ kàn le tā jiā fù jìn de zhào piàn.
lines.en: She shows me photos of the area near her home.

lines.zh: 春天的时候，那里有很多花。
lines.pinyin: Chūn tiān de shí hou, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā.
lines.en: There are many flowers there in spring.

lines.zh: 我问她最想念什么。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā zuì xiǎng niàn shén me.
lines.en: I ask what she misses most.

lines.zh: 她说，她最想念家里的小猫。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā zuì xiǎng niàn jiā lǐ de xiǎo māo.
lines.en: She says she misses her cat at home most.

lines.zh: 原来我们都很想家。
lines.pinyin: Yuán lái wǒ men dōu hěn xiǎng jiā.
lines.en: It turns out we both miss home.

lines.zh: 我有一个来自法国的朋友。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge lái zì Fǎ guó de péng you.
lines.en: I have a friend from France.

lines.zh: 法国在欧洲。
lines.pinyin: Fǎ guó zài Ōu zhōu.
lines.en: France is in Europe.

lines.zh: 我们在中文课上认识。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men zài Zhōng wén kè shang rèn shi.
lines.en: We meet in Chinese class.

lines.zh: 他喜欢做饭，我也喜欢。
lines.pinyin: Tā xǐ huan zuò fàn, wǒ yě xǐ huan.
lines.en: He likes cooking, and so do I.

lines.zh: 周末，他请我去他家吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Zhōu mò, tā qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā chī fàn.
lines.en: At the weekend, he invites me to eat at his home.

lines.zh: 我带了一盘自己做的菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dài le yì pán zì jǐ zuò de cài.
lines.en: I bring a dish I have made myself.

lines.zh: 我们用中文介绍桌上的食物。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men yòng Zhōng wén jiè shào zhuō shang de shí wù.
lines.en: We describe the food on the table in Chinese.

lines.zh: 学中文让我们成了朋友。
lines.pinyin: Xué Zhōng wén ràng wǒ men chéng le péng you.
lines.en: Learning Chinese has made us friends.

lines.zh: 我的室友来自肯尼亚。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shì yǒu lái zì Kěn ní yà.
lines.en: My roommate comes from Kenya.

lines.zh: 肯尼亚在非洲。
lines.pinyin: Kěn ní yà zài Fēi zhōu.
lines.en: Kenya is in Africa.

lines.zh: 我们每天一起去学校。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men měi tiān yì qǐ qù xué xiào.
lines.en: We go to school together every day.

lines.zh: 有一次，我问他家乡是什么样的。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì, wǒ wèn tā jiā xiāng shì shén me yàng de.
lines.en: Once, I ask what his hometown is like.

lines.zh: 他打开手机，给我看家人的照片。
lines.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi shǒu jī, gěi wǒ kàn jiā rén de zhào piàn.
lines.en: He opens his phone and shows me photos of his family.

lines.zh: 照片里，他正在和妹妹做饭。
lines.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ, tā zhèng zài hé mèi mei zuò fàn.
lines.en: In the photo, he is cooking with his younger sister.

lines.zh: 我发现我们喜欢的事情很像。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fā xiàn wǒ men xǐ huan de shì qing hěn xiàng.
lines.en: I discover that we like similar things.

lines.zh: 了解一个国家，可以从朋友开始。
lines.pinyin: Liǎo jiě yí ge guó jiā, kě yǐ cóng péng you kāi shǐ.
lines.en: Getting to know a country can begin with a friend.

title_en: A Postcard from Canada · North America

lines.zh: 今天，我收到一张明信片。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, wǒ shōu dào yì zhāng míng xìn piàn.
lines.en: Today, I receive a postcard.

lines.zh: 是我的朋友从加拿大寄来的。
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ de péng you cóng Jiā ná dà jì lái de.
lines.en: My friend sent it from Canada.

lines.zh: 加拿大在北美洲。
lines.pinyin: Jiā ná dà zài Běi měi zhōu.
lines.en: Canada is in North America.

lines.zh: 照片上有一个很大的湖。
lines.pinyin: Zhào piàn shang yǒu yí ge hěn dà de hú.
lines.en: There is a very large lake in the photo.

lines.zh: 朋友说，他周末去了那里。
lines.pinyin: Péng you shuō, tā zhōu mò qù le nà lǐ.
lines.en: My friend says he went there at the weekend.

lines.zh: 他还用中文写了我的名字。
lines.pinyin: Tā hái yòng Zhōng wén xiě le wǒ de míng zi.
lines.en: He also wrote my name in Chinese.

lines.zh: 我把明信片放在书桌上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ míng xìn piàn fàng zài shū zhuō shang.
lines.en: I put the postcard on my desk.

lines.zh: 我也想给他寄一张。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng gěi tā jì yì zhāng.
lines.en: I want to send him one, too.

title_en: A Language Partner from Brazil · South America

lines.zh: 我的语伴来自巴西。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de yǔ bàn lái zì Bā xī.
lines.en: My language partner is from Brazil.

lines.zh: 巴西在南美洲。
lines.pinyin: Bā xī zài Nán měi zhōu.
lines.en: Brazil is in South America.

lines.zh: 他在家里说葡萄牙语。
lines.pinyin: Tā zài jiā lǐ shuō Pú táo yá yǔ.
lines.en: He speaks Portuguese at home.

lines.zh: 我们每周见面练习中文。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men měi zhōu jiàn miàn liàn xí Zhōng wén.
lines.en: We meet every week to practice Chinese.

lines.zh: 今天，我们聊自己喜欢的运动。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, wǒ men liáo zì jǐ xǐ huan de yùn dòng.
lines.en: Today, we talk about sports we like.

lines.zh: 他喜欢游泳，我喜欢打篮球。
lines.pinyin: Tā xǐ huan yóu yǒng, wǒ xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú.
lines.en: He likes swimming, and I like basketball.

lines.zh: 遇到不会说的词，我们一起查。
lines.pinyin: Yù dào bú huì shuō de cí, wǒ men yì qǐ chá.
lines.en: When we find a word we cannot say, we look it up together.

lines.zh: 说错了也没关系，继续说就好。
lines.pinyin: Shuō cuò le yě méi guān xi, jì xù shuō jiù hǎo.
lines.en: Mistakes are okay. We just keep speaking.

lines.zh: 十二月，我给朋友打视频电话。
lines.pinyin: Shí èr yuè, wǒ gěi péng you dǎ shì pín diàn huà.
lines.en: In December, I video-call my friend.

lines.zh: 她住在澳大利亚。
lines.pinyin: Tā zhù zài Ào dà lì yà.
lines.en: She lives in Australia.

lines.zh: 澳大利亚在大洋洲。
lines.pinyin: Ào dà lì yà zài Dà yáng zhōu.
lines.en: Australia is in Oceania.

lines.zh: 我在北京，穿着厚厚的外套。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài Běi jīng, chuān zhe hòu hòu de wài tào.
lines.en: I am in Beijing, wearing a thick jacket.

lines.zh: 她却穿着短袖，准备去海边。
lines.pinyin: Tā què chuān zhe duǎn xiù, zhǔn bèi qù hǎi biān.
lines.en: She is wearing short sleeves and getting ready to go to the beach.

lines.zh: 我很惊讶，问她不冷吗。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn jīng yà, wèn tā bù lěng ma.
lines.en: I am surprised and ask whether she is cold.

lines.zh: 她笑着说，我们这里是夏天。
lines.pinyin: Tā xiào zhe shuō, wǒ men zhè lǐ shì xià tiān.
lines.en: She laughs and says it is summer there.

lines.zh: 同一个月份，季节却不一样。
lines.pinyin: Tóng yí ge yuè fèn, jì jié què bù yí yàng.
lines.en: It is the same month, but a different season.

lines.zh: 今天，我去学校办公室。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, wǒ qù xué xiào bàn gōng shì.
lines.en: Today, I go to the school office.

lines.zh: 老师告诉我明天的上课时间。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo shī gào su wǒ míng tiān de shàng kè shí jiān.
lines.en: The teacher tells me the time of class tomorrow.

lines.zh: 她说得很快，我没听懂。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō de hěn kuài, wǒ méi tīng dǒng.
lines.en: She speaks quickly, and I do not understand.

lines.zh: 我说，对不起，请说慢一点。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, duì bu qǐ, qǐng shuō màn yì diǎn.
lines.en: I say, sorry, please speak a little more slowly.

lines.zh: 老师笑了，又说了一次。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo shī xiào le, yòu shuō le yí cì.
lines.en: The teacher smiles and says it again.

lines.zh: 这次我听懂了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒ tīng dǒng le.
lines.en: This time, I understand.

lines.zh: 我把时间写在本子上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shí jiān xiě zài běn zi shang.
lines.en: I write the time in my notebook.

lines.zh: 不懂的时候，我可以问。
lines.pinyin: Bù dǒng de shí hou, wǒ kě yǐ wèn.
lines.en: When I do not understand, I can ask.

lines.zh: 今天晚上，我有一点想家。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǎn shang, wǒ yǒu yì diǎn xiǎng jiā.
lines.en: This evening, I miss home a little.

lines.zh: 我给妈妈打了视频电话。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi mā ma dǎ le shì pín diàn huà.
lines.en: I make a video call to my mother.

lines.zh: 她正在厨房里做早饭。
lines.pinyin: Tā zhèng zài chú fáng lǐ zuò zǎo fàn.
lines.en: She is making breakfast in the kitchen.

lines.zh: 我们那里的时间不一样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men nà lǐ de shí jiān bù yí yàng.
lines.en: The time back home is different.

lines.zh: 我给她看了我的房间。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā kàn le wǒ de fáng jiān.
lines.en: I show her my room.

lines.zh: 她问我吃得好不好。
lines.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ chī de hǎo bu hǎo.
lines.en: She asks whether I am eating well.

lines.zh: 我说很好，还交了新朋友。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō hěn hǎo, hái jiāo le xīn péng you.
lines.en: I say yes, and that I have made new friends.

lines.zh: 聊完以后，我的心情好多了。
lines.pinyin: Liáo wán yǐ hòu, wǒ de xīn qíng hǎo duō le.
lines.en: After our chat, I feel much better.

lines.zh: 我和室友的作息不太一样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hé shì yǒu de zuò xī bú tài yí yàng.
lines.en: My roommate and I have different daily routines.

lines.zh: 我喜欢早睡，他习惯晚睡。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan zǎo shuì, tā xí guàn wǎn shuì.
lines.en: I like sleeping early; he is used to sleeping late.

lines.zh: 昨天晚上，他打电话打到很晚。
lines.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shang, tā dǎ diàn huà dǎ dào hěn wǎn.
lines.en: Last night, he stayed on the phone until late.

lines.zh: 今天，我决定和他商量一下。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, wǒ jué dìng hé tā shāng liang yí xià.
lines.en: Today, I decide to discuss it with him.

lines.zh: 我说，十点以后能小声一点吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, shí diǎn yǐ hòu néng xiǎo shēng yì diǎn ma?
lines.en: I ask if he can keep his voice down after ten.

lines.zh: 他说，没问题，对不起。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, méi wèn tí, duì bu qǐ.
lines.en: He says, no problem, sorry.

lines.zh: 我们还一起安排了打扫的时间。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men hái yì qǐ ān pái le dǎ sǎo de shí jiān.
lines.en: We also agree on a cleaning schedule.

lines.zh: 把想法说清楚，住在一起更舒服。
lines.pinyin: Bǎ xiǎng fǎ shuō qīng chu, zhù zài yì qǐ gèng shū fu.
lines.en: Sharing our thoughts clearly makes living together more comfortable.

lines.zh: 我和朋友去一家小饭馆。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hé péng you qù yì jiā xiǎo fàn guǎn.
lines.en: My friend and I go to a small restaurant.

lines.zh: 菜单上有很多我想吃的菜。
lines.pinyin: Cài dān shang yǒu hěn duō wǒ xiǎng chī de cài.
lines.en: There are many dishes I want to try on the menu.

lines.zh: 可是，我不太能吃辣。
lines.pinyin: Kě shì, wǒ bú tài néng chī là.
lines.en: But I cannot eat very spicy food.

lines.zh: 我问服务员，这个菜辣吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn fú wù yuán, zhè ge cài là ma?
lines.en: I ask the server whether this dish is spicy.

lines.zh: 她说，有一点辣。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, yǒu yì diǎn là.
lines.en: She says it is a little spicy.

lines.zh: 我说，请少放一点辣椒。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shuō, qǐng shǎo fàng yì diǎn là jiāo.
lines.en: I say, please use a little less chili.

lines.zh: 菜来了，味道正好。
lines.pinyin: Cài lái le, wèi dào zhèng hǎo.
lines.en: The food arrives, and the flavor is just right.

lines.zh: 原来我可以说出自己的需要。
lines.pinyin: Yuán lái wǒ kě yǐ shuō chū zì jǐ de xū yào.
lines.en: I realize I can say what I need.

lines.zh: 手机上收到了一条消息。
lines.pinyin: Shǒu jī shang shōu dào le yì tiáo xiāo xi.
lines.en: I receive a message on my phone.

lines.zh: 我买的书已经到了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de shū yǐ jīng dào le.
lines.en: The books I bought have arrived.

lines.zh: 消息让我去楼下取快递。
lines.pinyin: Xiāo xi ràng wǒ qù lóu xià qǔ kuài dì.
lines.en: The message tells me to collect the parcel downstairs.

lines.zh: 我带着手机走到服务台。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dài zhe shǒu jī zǒu dào fú wù tái.
lines.en: I take my phone to the service desk.

lines.zh: 工作人员问我取件码是多少。
lines.pinyin: Gōng zuò rén yuán wèn wǒ qǔ jiàn mǎ shì duō shao.
lines.en: The staff member asks for my pickup code.

lines.zh: 我把消息给他看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xiāo xi gěi tā kàn.
lines.en: I show him the message.

lines.zh: 他很快就找到了我的包裹。
lines.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù zhǎo dào le wǒ de bāo guǒ.
lines.en: He quickly finds my parcel.

lines.zh: 回到房间，我马上开始看新书。
lines.pinyin: Huí dào fáng jiān, wǒ mǎ shàng kāi shǐ kàn xīn shū.
lines.en: Back in my room, I start reading my new book right away.

lines.zh: 今天，班里来了一个新同学。
lines.pinyin: Jīn tiān, bān lǐ lái le yí ge xīn tóng xué.
lines.en: Today, a new student joins our class.

lines.zh: 他问我的名字怎么读。
lines.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ de míng zi zěn me dú.
lines.en: He asks how to say my name.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地说了一次。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ màn màn de shuō le yí cì.
lines.en: I say it slowly once.

lines.zh: 他跟着我读，读得很好。
lines.pinyin: Tā gēn zhe wǒ dú, dú de hěn hǎo.
lines.en: He repeats after me and says it well.

lines.zh: 然后，我也问了他的名字。
lines.pinyin: Rán hòu, wǒ yě wèn le tā de míng zi.
lines.en: Then I ask his name, too.

lines.zh: 我们把名字写在纸上。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ míng zi xiě zài zhǐ shang.
lines.en: We write our names on paper.

lines.zh: 下课时，他已经记住了我的名字。
lines.pinyin: Xià kè shí, tā yǐ jīng jì zhù le wǒ de míng zi.
lines.en: By the end of class, he remembers my name.

lines.zh: 我觉得很高兴，也记住了他的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jué de hěn gāo xìng, yě jì zhù le tā de.
lines.en: I feel happy, and I remember his, too.
